controller id help: Only needed if the account has more than one controller
customer interval help: The API allows only 5 requests per 5 minutes to this endpoint. The data (controller name, serial number) barely changes.
header v2: API v2 (GraphQL) - water usage and sensors
leak threshold help: Sets water.leakSuspected when more water flowed today than the watering runs account for. In the unit of your account (litres/gallons), 0 disables the check.
v2 hint: The v1 API cannot report water usage. The v2 API used by the Hydrawise app reports flow meter volumes, per zone water usage, sensor states and rainfall - it needs the e-mail address and password of your Hydrawise account.
